basics.name: Skyler Remata
basics.label: Student
basics.summary: I am a full-time student at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa. I am currently in my third year studying for my B.S. in Computer Science - Security Science, and my expected date of graduation is Spring 2028.

awards.title: Man Second Century Scholarship
awards.summary: Enroll in at least 6 UH Mānoa credits applicable toward your degree.

awards.title: Mānoa Opportunity Grant
awards.summary: Undergraduate student – you must be a first time Bachelor’s degree seeker, enrolled in at least 6 UH Mānoa credits applicable toward your degree.

awards.title: Mānoa Academic Merit Scholarship
awards.summary: The Mānoa Academic Merit Scholarship program is designed to recognize the academic strengths of first-year, degree-seeking students who enroll at UH Mānoa in the semester following the completion of their high school diploma.
